map.备孕、服药（如头孢）、驾车前，依据体重与代谢时长预估血液酒精清零所需时间，决定是: Before trying to conceive, taking medication (such as cephalosporins) or driving, estimate the time needed for the blood alcohol to clear based on body weight and the elimination period, and decide whether to postpone the trip.
map.大体重者略快、空腹饮更快达峰，但清零时间应以「总纯酒精 ÷ 代谢速率」估算，且个: Heavier people clear slightly faster and drinking on an empty stomach peaks faster, but the clearance time should be estimated as "total pure alcohol ÷ elimination rate", and individual differences are large, so before driving rely on a breath or blood test rather than on the calculation
map.对比不同饮品（啤酒/红酒/白酒）的酒精贡献，选择低度或控制杯数，避免「混饮误判」: Compare the alcohol contribution of different drinks (beer / red wine / spirits), choose low-alcohol options or limit the number of drinks, and avoid a "mixed-drink misjudgement".
map.应酬或聚餐饮酒后，估算当晚摄入的纯酒精克数与「标准杯」数，对照每日/单次安全上限: After a business dinner or a party with drinks, estimate the grams of pure alcohol and the number of "standard drinks" consumed that night, and compare against the daily or per-occasion safety limit to judge whether it was excessive.
map.标准杯按纯酒精约 14 g 折算，与容器大小无关。啤酒（5%/330ml）约 0: A standard drink is converted from about 14 g of pure alcohol and is independent of the container size. Beer (5% / 330ml) is about 0.6 drinks, red wine (13% / 150ml) about 1.4, and spirits (52% / 50ml) about 1.5; convert separately by alcohol content and volume rather than simply counting glasses.
map.肝脏代谢速率约 0.015 g/kg/h 且与体重、性别、肝功能相关，并非线性。: The liver metabolic rate is about 0.015 g/kg/h and depends on body weight, sex and liver function, so it is not linear. Heavier people clear slightly faster and drinking on an empty stomach peaks faster, but the clearance time should be estimated as "total pure alcohol ÷ metabolic rate", and individual differences are large, so before driving rely on a breath or blood test rather than on the calculation.
